description: No hooks. The Stop hook that auto-dispatched the lens is RETIRED as of 0.5.0 — its trigger now ships as the 'quality-lens' duty in the turn-end plugin. It fired 8 times over a single user request: its fire-once guard bounded CONSECUTIVE blocks rather than total fires (a steady 50% duty cycle), and it keyed on a hash of the turn's text, so every correction turn looked new. The duty keys on prompt_id instead — the user-request span.
